title: Owens-Wilson Debate Clip Fallout: Candace Owens grills Andrew Wilson; Utah judge weighs capital case
summary_full: Candace Owens has reignited controversy surrounding her debate with Andrew Wilson after challenging him to name a charge against Tyler Robinson. Owens later argued that the question was not intended as a “gotcha,” but reflected her desire to discuss Utah’s law and the case’s aggravating factor. She accused Wilson of wasting viewers’ time and questioned his preparation, while the viral exchange sparked renewed debate over Robinson’s charges and the broader case.
